headline: IT services grew modestly in Q2 FY27, with AI driving incremental revenue for several leaders.
summary: Revenue growth across the sector ranged from 1.5% to 53.6% YoY, with TCS and HCLTech delivering solid operating margins. AI revenue and deal wins were highlighted by TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, and Wipro, indicating a continued shift toward AI‑native services. Dividend payouts remained strong, and guidance was generally stable or slightly trimmed.

themes.title: AI‑Native Growth
themes.detail: Companies that emphasized AI, such as TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, and Wipro, reported higher deal wins and revenue contributions from AI services.

themes.title: Margin Discipline
themes.detail: TCS and HCLTech maintained operating margins above 20%, while others like Coforge and Tech Mahindra improved or raised margin guidance.
